description: Source code for a build system with classes for different build methods (cmake, automake, hostap), and a mapbuild class to orchestrate building modules and dependencies based on command-line arguments.

classes.name: builder
classes.description: Base class for build configurations, requiring prepare() and make() methods to be implemented.

classes.name: cmakebuilder
classes.description: Derived class for CMake-based build process, handling preparation and build steps.

classes.name: acbuilder
classes.description: Derived class for automake-based build process, handling configuration and build steps.

classes.name: hostapbuilder
classes.description: Build class for hostapd, handling configuration, preparation, and installation.

classes.name: mapbuild
classes.description: Main class orchestrating building of modules and dependencies based on command-line arguments.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Removes build directories or uninstalls modules.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the build environment, e.g., runs configuration scripts.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the build environment for automake projects.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes build commands based on user input.
